findings: An infiltrative pancreatic cancer measuring 39 mm is observed in the head of the pancreas. The common bile duct is interrupted by the tumor, suggesting invasion. Serosal invasion and retropancreatic tissue invasion are noted. There is contact of more than 180° with the portal vein, suggesting invasion. No invasion beyond the inferior border of the duodenum is observed. No other local invasion factors are identified. Lymph node metastases are observed in one node at station 12a and three nodes at station 12b. No other metastases are observed.

responses.content:
Task 1: Diagnose the local invasion factors of pancreatic cancer.

CH1 (Common bile duct invasion)
DU0 (No invasion beyond the inferior border of the duodenum)
S1 (Serosal invasion)
RP1 (Retropancreatic tissue invasion)
PV1 (Portal vein invasion)
A0 (No invasion of the arterial structures)
PL0 (No invasion of the pancreatic lymphatic vessels)
OO1 (Invasion of the omentum or other organs)

Task 2: Determine the classification for local invasion (T classification) of pancreatic cancer.

Based on the size of the tumor (39 mm) and the presence of invasion factors, the T classification is T3.

Task 3: Determine the N classification of pancreatic cancer.

Regional lymph nodes for pancreatic cancer are defined as follows:
- Head of the pancreas: stations 12a, 12b, 13, 14, 15, 16, 17
- Body of the pancreas: stations 8a, 8b, 9, 10, 11
- Tail of the pancreas: stations 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7

The patient's metastatic lymph node stations are 12a and 12b, which are regional for the head of the pancreas. Counting only the metastatic lymph nodes within the regional stations, there are 4 involved regional nodes.

N classification: N1b

Task 4: Determine the M classification of pancreatic cancer.

There are no distant metastases observed, so the M classification is M0.

Task 5: Determine the resectability classification of pancreatic cancer.

Based on the results of Task 1 and Task 4, the tumor is resectable because there are no distant or non-regional metastases, and the local invasion factors do not meet the criteria for borderline resectable or unresectable.

Resectability classification: R

Task 6: Determine the overall stage according to the JPS staging system.

T classification: T3
N classification: N1b
M classification: M0

Stage classification: Stage IIA
